bway-r-30.audit_note8: Not required: one shoulder closed (Note 8's Case 11 exception). Signs placed: 0 left, 8 right. MUTCD 11th Ed. Fig. 6P-3 Note 1 (p. 864): “A SHOULDER WORK sign should be placed on the left-hand side of the roadway for a divided or one-way street only if the left-hand shoulder is affected.” Denver: DOTI PT-116.1 (2022) and Rule 22.3 (2022) read; both defer sign placement to the MUTCD and set no sign-side rule. DOTI standards and details not read.
crew_note8_lines: - One-way street: signs go on the closed shoulder's side only, under the single-shoulder exception in CDOT S-630-1 Sheet 2 General Note 8 (and MUTCD 11th Ed. Fig. 6P-3 Note 1, p. 864). Offsets are measured from the left edge of the roadway.
